blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Cordova Public College (CPC) Eels pulled off a gritty come-from-behind overtime victory over last season’s finalists, the Talisay City College (TCC) Talisalites, 91-83, to highlight the action in the Metro Cebu Collegiate Basketball League (MCCBL) Season 2 on Tuesday, November 10, at the Cebu City Sports Institute. Trailing by as many as 14 points in the third quarter, 48-62, the Eels mounted a furious comeback in the final period before outplaying the Talisalites in overtime to complete their impressive victory. CPC’s Franco Gabunada spearheaded the comeback with a game-high 25 points, five assists, and three rebounds, […]...
